content:
🔥

Special thanks to Bryan – our host and server manager. He funded the server, set everything up, and handles all the day‑to‑day operations and administration. From choosing the modpack and configuring the backend, to drafting the rules and keeping the community running smoothly – every part of this SMP exists because of his time and dedication. Without his passion and effort, this community simply wouldn’t be here.

 

 

We also ask everyone to enjoy the game while keeping the admin’s hard work in mind – please follow the rules and help us maintain this fun, friendly world we’ve built together.

 

Once again, our deepest gratitude to Bryan! 🎉🙏

📝 Jom to UoSM

📋

Server Rules (Quick Recap)

No griefing

Don’t be a jerk: no stealing; PvP is allowed, but spawncamping is not.

Have fun

The End is locked for the first 7 days (to slow down early dragon kills).

Server is hosted in Singapore, running in offline/insecure mode – you do not need a paid Minecraft account.

CUT DOWN YOUR TREES FULLY！

🛠️ Step 1 – Choose a Launcher

Recommended: X Minecraft Launcher (XMCLXMCL - A fully featured Minecraft launcher | XMCL

XMCL - A fully featured Minecraft launcher | XMCL

Empower Your Minecraft Experience with modern launcher

XMCL

).

If you prefer another launcher (e.g., MultiMC, Prism, GDLauncher), the steps are similar – you can find guides online.

The pack is currently still under review on CurseForge, so auto-install from the launcher may not work yet.

🖥️ Step 3 – Install the Modpack Manually (for X Launcher)

Open X Minecraft Launcher.

On the left sidebar, look for the “Import” button (it usually looks like a folder or a plus icon).

Select the UoSMP.zip file you downloaded.

The launcher will unpack and install all mods automatically.

After it finishes, select the pack from your versions list and click Launch.

For other launchers: the import option is usually called “Add instance” or “Import from zip” – use that.

🌐 Step 4 – Connect to the Server

Once in-game, go to Multiplayer → Add Server.

Enter the server IP/domain “ 23.109.123.95:25592 ”.

23.109.123.95:25592

Because the server is in offline mode, you don’t need to log in with a Microsoft/Mojang account. Just set your username in the launcher’s account settings (choose “Offline” mode and type your desired name).

Click Join Server – and you’re in!

⚠️ Common Tips & Troubleshooting

First launch may take a while as it downloads additional resources – be patient.

If you get missing mod errors, try re‑importing the zip or check your internet connection (CurseForge may be slow in some regions).

The End portal will be inaccessible for the first 7 days – after that, it opens automatically.

Remember the rules – breaking them can get you kicked or banned.

If you are still experiencing FPS Issues on the LITE pack, you can go into resource packs and click on the button on the top left

and select LITE, you can also do this on the Default pack if your FPS dips just a little.

Mod List Guide

🧱 Content Mods (Core Gameplay)

Mod

What it does

How to get started

Create

Build contraptions and automate processes using rotational power. Adds many mechanical components and block variants.

Use the Ponder function (hover over any Create item and hold the key prompt) or check the official wiki.

Refined Storage

Store large quantities of items easily, with autocrafting and automation.

Craft a controller, drives, and disks, then connect a terminal to access your network.

Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks

RPG‑style magic system with spells and spellbooks.

Find spellbooks and a wand, then follow in‑game guides to learn spells.

Iron's Gems & Jewelry

Craft modular jewelry pieces with different patterns and materials.

Hunt for jewelcrafting patterns, then use a jewelry workbench to create your pieces.

Block Pack

Adds 1200+ decorative and functional furniture blocks in vanilla style.

Start by crafting the Blockpack Workbench to browse and craft all blocks.

NetherEx

Expands the Nether with new biomes, blocks, items, and mobs.

Explore the Nether normally – new content appears naturally.

Farmer's Delight + addons

Adds a wide variety of new food and cooking mechanics.

Craft a cooking pot and cutting board, then start planting new crops.

Artifacts & Relics

Adds upgradeable wearable artifacts.

Press E to open your inventory and click the accessories icon next to your player model to equip them.

Malum

A magic mod focused on spirit arcana.

Read the in‑game guidebook called Encyclopedia Arcana.

Starcatcher

A high‑quality fishing overhaul.

Read the Starcatcher's Guide to learn the new mechanics.

Simply Swords

Adds many unique new swords.

Craft or find them – no special guide needed.

Enchanted

Adds ~120 new enchantments.

Use an enchanting table or find them in loot.

Modified

Adds equipment tiers with modifiers; lets you upgrade and reroll stats.

Use the Reforging Anvil to ascend items to higher tiers and reroll modifiers.

Immersive Aircraft

Adds flyable airplanes.

Craft plane parts and assemble them.

Exposure

Adds a realistic camera and photo development system.

Craft a camera, film, and set up a darkroom to develop photos.

Joy of Painting

Allows you to create pixel art and place it on canvases.

Open the painting interface and start drawing.

🛠️ QOL / Utility Mods

Mod

What it does

Keybind / How to use

JEI + addons

Recipe viewer: shows how to craft items and what they're used for.

Hover over an item and press R to see recipes, U to see uses.

Xaero's Map

Minimap + full‑screen map with waypoints.

Press M to open the full map; you can add waypoints from there.

Ping Wheel

Send location pings to other players.

Default: Mouse Button 5 (configurable). Adjust max ping distance in settings if it gets noisy.

Simple Voice Chat

Proximity‑based voice chat in game.

Press N to open the configuration menu.

Mouse Tweaks

Quickly move items with the mouse wheel.

Hover over a slot and scroll to transfer one item at a time.

Gravestones

Keeps your items on death – a gravestone appears.

Break your own gravestone to retrieve your items (only the owner can).

Lootr

Makes chest loot per‑player – everyone can loot the same chest independently.

Do not break the chests – just right‑click to claim your loot.

Comforts

Adds sleeping bags (lets you sleep without resetting spawn point).

Craft and use a sleeping bag.

Keybind Atlas

Visual overview of all keybinds.

Esc → Options → Controls → Open Keybind Atlas.

Quick Skin

Change your skin in‑game.

Open the mod interface and select a new skin.

Grind Enchantments

Transfer enchantments from an item to a book (item is returned unenchanted).

Put an enchanted item + a book into a grindstone – you get the enchanted book and the clean item back.

📌 Quick Tips for New Players

When you first join, press E and check your accessories slot (next to your character).

Browse JEI – type @create or @refined to quickly see all items from those mods.

Use the Ponder feature for Create – it's more helpful than reading wikis.

Set up your Voice Chat and Ping Wheel early – they make team coordination much easier.

📌 Final Note

💡

If you run into any issues (e.g., launcher-specific questions), feel free to ask. Otherwise, enjoy the server! 🎮

 

Once again, huge thanks to Bryan for hosting and managing this server – it takes a lot of his time, effort, and money behind the scenes. 
If you're enjoying the experience and feel like showing a little extra appreciation, you're welcome to buy him a coffee – this is completely optional and not required at all.

Here is the donation link (Touch ‘n Go E-Wallet). But even if you don't, a simple "thank you" goes a long way in letting him know his work is valued. ☕
